agent.name: MarketNow — Agent Skill Exchange
agent.description: The largest MCP skill marketplace for AI agents. Browse 9,248 verified MCP servers, each secured by Sentinel v3.0 gVisor sandbox security audit. Agents can discover, install, and recommend MCP skills to other agents, earning commission on referrals. Supports MCP (Model Context Protocol), A2A (Agent-to-Agent), and JSON-RPC transports.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the marketplace for MCP skills by query, category, or minimum security score

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Retrieve full metadata, install command, and security score for a specific skill

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List all available skill categories with counts

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check marketplace API connectivity and stats

services.name: MCP Skill Search
services.description: AI agents can search and retrieve MCP server configurations from 9,248 verified skills. Supports natural language queries, category filtering, and security score thresholds.

atc.description: Agent Trust Card — identity, trust score, and payment for AI agents. The trust layer for A2A + MCP.

economy.model: Marketplace with commission: sellers list skills (free or premium), buyers install free or pay seller's price
economy.buyer_pricing: Free skills cost nothing. Premium skills have a one-time price set by the seller (typically free)

seller_pricing.listing: Free — list unlimited skills at no cost
seller_pricing.SENTINEL_PRO: $9.99/mo — Sentinel v3.0 audit on every skill
seller_pricing.SENTINEL_ENTERPRISE: $49.99/mo — gVisor sandbox + priority listing + API access

economy.seller_revenue: Sellers keep 80% of every premium skill sale. MarketNow takes 20% commission.
revenue_streams: 20% commission on premium skill sales (main revenue)
economy.buyer_value: Free skills install instantly. Premium skills are one-time purchases with full chargeback rights via Stripe or USDC.
economy.seller_value: Sell skills to 9,248+ users. Keep 80% of sales. Get Sentinel v3.0 security audit to boost trust and conversion.

audit_applied.auditor: Independent audit via Z.ai (not affiliated with AliceLabs LLC)
audit_applied.audit_scope: Documented inconsistencies across agent.json, npm package.json, LICENSE files, README, and landing HTML.

pricing_source_of_truth: agent.json is the canonical pricing source. Landing page and README must match. MarketNow does NOT sell skills to buyers — buyers install all 9,248 skills free. Revenue comes from sellers who subscribe to Sentinel (PRO $9.99/mo, ENTERPRISE $49.99/mo) and 20% commission on seller sales.

buyer_pricing.explanation: Buyers never pay MarketNow. All 9,248 skills are free to install.

api_notes.skills_pagination: The /api/skills endpoint is paginated (default 100 per page, max 500). The old /api/skills.json (24MB) is deprecated — use /api/skills?page=1&limit=100 instead.
